title: Answer the open Harbor Goods product questions
item: Answer the open Harbor Goods product questions
motivation: Every trial leaves them open because the stand-in owner cannot decide them, so the example spec carries known open questions
notes: Main one: what ends lookup retries (the recorded answer is "without limit"; the owner now thinks that is wrong). Also: what the agent does when the order list returns an error; a refund that fails after it was issued; and five decisions from the first checker run (shipped order plus a part-order request; an order cancelled with no refund; acting on the lookup after a second unanswered cancel; an order shipping mid-call; a timed-out cancel landing late). Recommended answers are in the handoff. Changing recorded answers changes the test input, so rebaseline after. ANSWERED 2026-11-19 (owner, in the founder_and_builder project chat, "yes to all" after changing rows 5, 6 and 8): nine answers and one rule on contradicting answers, recorded by Claude in chat on 2026-11-20 in eval/agent-spec/review-packet.md, section "Owner answers, 2026-11-19 (task 29)". Row 5 is not the earlier handoff's recommendation: with no refund on a cancelled order the agent proposes the refund itself; only a failed refund goes to staff. NOT DONE HERE: no rebaseline. switch-base-10 to -12 were built on the old answers.
done_means: The owner's answer is recorded for each open question, starting with what ends lookup retries. The frozen trial inputs that hold his answers are updated.
draft_note: May edit must name the frozen trial inputs that record his answers; set when he answers.
